evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: A task sent by a remote peer over A2A is treated as a legitimate request, providing a natural channel for indirect prompt injection.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: Existing agent security evaluations mostly rely on a single metric, the attack success rate (ASR), and cannot distinguish whether an attack failed because the LLM recognized the malicious content or because a mechanism at the agent layer blocked execution.
